use catalog.{CatalogError, Product, find, products}
use users.{users}

table orders: Order key id

type Line {
  sku: String,
  quantity: Int,
}

type Order {

  lines: List[Line],
  total: Int,
  status: Status,
}

type Status =
  | Open
  | Paid(receipt: String)
  | Cancelled

type NewOrder {
  email: String,
  lines: List[Line],
}

type Summary {
  email: String,
  orders: Int,
  spent: Int,
}

fn line_total(l: Line) -> Int
  effects: store(products)
  ensures: result >= 0
{
  return match find(l.sku) {
    Ok(p) => p.cents * l.quantity,
    Err(_) => 0,
  }
}

api fn place_order(input: NewOrder) -> Result[Order, CatalogError]
  route: POST "/orders"
  effects: store(orders), store(products)
  requires: len(input.lines) > 0
{
  var total = 0
  for line in input.lines {
    let p = try find(line.sku)
    total = total + p.cents * line.quantity
  }
  let order = Order {
    id: next_id(orders),
    email: input.email,
    lines: input.lines,
    total: total,
    status: Open,
  }
  insert(orders, order)
  return Ok(order)
}

api fn pay(id: Int) -> Result[Order, CatalogError]
  route: POST "/orders/{id}/pay"
  effects: net(payments.example.com), store(orders)
{
  return match get(orders, id) {
    Some(o) => match http_post("https://payments.example.com/charge", to_string(o.total)) {
      Ok(receipt) => Ok(save(orders, paid(o, receipt))),
      Err(e) => Err(Missing(e.message)),
    },
    None => Err(Missing("order " + to_string(id))),
  }
}

fn paid(o: Order, receipt: String) -> Order {
  var out = o
  out.status = Paid(receipt)
  return out
}

api fn summaries() -> List[Summary]
  route: GET "/summaries"
  effects: store(orders)
{
  let groups = group_by(scan(orders), |o| o.email)
  let rows = map(
    groups,
    |g| Summary { email: g.0, orders: len(g.1), spent: fold(g.1, 0, |acc, o| acc + o.total) },
  )
  return sort_desc_by(rows, |s| s.spent)
}

api fn open_count(email: String) -> Int
  route: GET "/orders/open"
  effects: store(orders)
{
  var n = 0
  for o in scan(orders) {
    if o.email == email {
      n = n + (match o.status {
        Open => 1,
        _ => 0,
      })
    }
  }
  return n
}

api fn customers() -> List[(String, Int)]
  route: GET "/customers"
  effects: store(orders), store(users)
{
  let names = map(scan(users), |u| u.name)
  return map(enumerate(names), |i, n| (n, i + count(orders)))
}

api fn first_email() -> Option[String]
  route: GET "/orders/first"
  effects: store(orders)
{
  let all = scan(orders)
  return match first(all) {
    Some(o) => Some(o.email),
    None => None,
  }
}

api fn list_orders(email: String, page: Int, per_page: Int) -> List[Order]
  route: GET "/orders"
  effects: store(orders)
  requires: page >= 1 && per_page >= 1 && per_page <= 20
{
  let all = sort_by(scan(orders), |o| o.id)
  let for_user = filter(all, |o| o.email == email)
  return take(drop(for_user, (page - 1) * per_page), per_page)
}

import json
import sqlite3

from fastapi import APIRouter

from .db import transaction
from .errors import ApiError, InvalidRequest
from .schemas import Product, Restock, TagCount

router = APIRouter()


def row_to_product(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Product:
    return Product(
        sku=row["sku"],
        name=row["name"],
        cents=row["cents"],
        stock=row["stock"],
        tags=json.loads(row["tags"]),
    )


def find_product(conn: sqlite3.Connection, sku: str) -> Product | None:
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM products WHERE sku = ?", (sku,)).fetchone()
    return row_to_product(row) if row else None


def all_products(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Product]:
    return [
        row_to_product(r) for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY pos")
    ]


def save_product(conn: sqlite3.Connection, product: Product) -> None:
    values = (
        product.name,
        product.cents,
        product.stock,
        json.dumps(product.tags),
        product.sku,
    )
    updated = conn.execute(
        "UPDATE products SET name = ?, cents = ?, stock = ?, tags = ? WHERE sku = ?",
        values,
    )
    if updated.rowcount == 0:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO products (name, cents, stock, tags, sku) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            values,
        )


def price_label(cents: int) -> str:
    """The price as dollars and cents, like $19.99."""
    return f"${cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}"


@router.post("/products")
def add_product(product: Product) -> Product:
    if len(product.sku) < 3 or product.cents < 0 or product.stock < 0:
        raise InvalidRequest(
            "the sku has at least 3 characters, and cents and stock are not negative"
        )
    with transaction() as conn:
        if find_product(conn, product.sku):
            raise ApiError("Invalid", reason=f"duplicate sku {product.sku}")
        save_product(conn, product)
    return product


@router.get("/products/{sku}")
def get_product(sku: str) -> Product:
    with transaction() as conn:
        product = find_product(conn, sku)
    if product is None:
        raise ApiError("Missing", sku=sku)
    return product


@router.get("/products")
def list_products(page: int, per_page: int, tag: str | None = None) -> list[Product]:
    if page < 1 or not 1 <= per_page <= 50:
        raise InvalidRequest("page is at least 1, and per_page is between 1 and 50")
    with transaction() as conn:
        products = sorted(all_products(conn), key=lambda p: p.sku)
    if tag is not None:
        products = [p for p in products if tag in p.tags]
    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    return products[start : start + per_page]


@router.patch("/products/{sku}/stock")
def restock(sku: str, body: Restock) -> Product:
    if body.amount <= 0:
        raise InvalidRequest("the amount is positive")
    with transaction() as conn:
        product = find_product(conn, sku)
        if product is None:
            raise ApiError("Missing", sku=sku)
        # validating the new stock rejects an overflow before it is saved
        updated = Product.model_validate(
            {**product.model_dump(), "stock": product.stock + body.amount}
        )
        save_product(conn, updated)
    return updated


@router.get("/prices")
def price_table() -> dict[str, str]:
    with transaction() as conn:
        return {p.sku: price_label(p.cents) for p in all_products(conn)}


@router.delete("/products/{sku}")
def delete_product(sku: str) -> bool:
    with transaction() as conn:
        return conn.execute("DELETE FROM products WHERE sku = ?", (sku,)).rowcount > 0


@router.get("/average")
def average_cents(skus: str) -> int:
    wanted = skus.split(",")
    with transaction() as conn:
        found = [p for p in all_products(conn) if p.sku in wanted]
    return sum(p.cents for p in found) // len(found)


@router.get("/tags/counts")

import json
import sqlite3
from typing import Annotated, Iterable

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends

from .db import transaction
from .errors import ApiError, InvalidRequest
from .schemas import Product, Restock


router = APIRouter()


def row_to_product(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Product:
    return Product(
        sku=row["sku"],
        name=row["name"],
        cents=row["cents"],
        stock=row["stock"],
        tags=json.loads(row["tags"]),
    )


def find_product(conn: sqlite3.Connection, sku: str) -> Product | None:
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM products WHERE sku = ?", (sku,)).fetchone()
    return row_to_product(row) if row else None


def all_products(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Product]:
    return [
        row_to_product(r) for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY pos")
    ]


def save_product(conn: sqlite3.Connection, product: Product) -> None:
    values = (
        product.name,
        product.cents,
        product.stock,
        json.dumps(product.tags),
        product.sku,
    )
    updated = conn.execute(
        "UPDATE products SET name = ?, cents = ?, stock = ?, tags = ? WHERE sku = ?",
        values,
    )
    if updated.rowcount == 0:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO products (name, cents, stock, tags, sku) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            values,
        )


def price_label(cents: int) -> str:
    """The price as dollars and cents, like $19.99."""
    return f"${cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}"


@router.post("/products")
def add_product(product: Product) -> Product:
    if len(product.sku) < 3 or product.cents < 0 or product.stock < 0:
        raise InvalidRequest(
            "the sku has at least 3 characters, and cents and stock are not negative"
        )
    with transaction() as conn:
        if find_product(conn, product.sku):
            raise ApiError("Invalid", reason=f"duplicate sku {product.sku}")
        save_product(conn, product)
    return product


@router.get("/products/{sku}")
def get_product(sku: str) -> Product:
    with transaction() as conn:
        product = find_product(conn, sku)
    if product is None:
        raise ApiError("Missing", sku=sku)
    return product


@router.get("/products")
def list_products(page: int, per_page: int, tag: str | None = None) -> list[Product]:
    if page < 1 or not 1 <= per_page <= 50:
        raise InvalidRequest("page is at least 1, and per_page is between 1 and 50")
    with transaction() as conn:
        products = sorted(all_products(conn), key=lambda p: p.sku)
    if tag is not None:
        products = [p for p in products if tag in p.tags]
    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    return products[start : start + per_page]


@router.patch("/products/{sku}/stock")
def restock(sku: str, body: Restock) -> Product:
    if body.amount <= 0:
        raise InvalidRequest("the amount is positive")
    with transaction() as conn:
        product = find_product(conn, sku)
        if product is None:
            raise ApiError("Missing", sku=sku)
        # validating the new stock rejects an overflow before it is saved
        updated = Product.model_validate(
            {**product.model_dump(), "stock": product.stock + body.amount}
        )
        save_product(conn, updated)
    return updated


@router.get("/prices")
def price_table() -> dict[str, str]:
    with transaction() as conn:
        return {p.sku: price_label(p.cents) for p in all_products(conn)}


@router.delete("/products/{sku}")
def delete_product(sku: str) -> bool:
    with transaction() as conn:
        return conn.execute("DELETE FROM products WHERE sku = ?", (sku,)).rowcount > 0


@router.get("/average")
def average_cents(skus: str) -> int:
    wanted = skus.split(",")
    with transaction() as conn:
        found = [p for p in all_products(conn) if p.sku in wanted]
    return sum(p.cents for p in found) // len(found)


@router.get("/products/{sku}/related")
def related_products(sku: str) -> Iterable[Product]:
    with transaction() as conn:
        product = find_product(conn, sku)
        if product is None:
            raise ApiError("Missing", sku=sku)
        related = [
            p for p in all_products(conn)
            if p.sku != sku and len(set(product.tags) & set(p.tags)) > 0
        ]
        related.sort(key=lambda p: (-len(set(product.tags) & set(p.tags)), p.sku))
        return related

    values = (
        product.name,
        product.cents,
        product.stock,
        json.dumps(product.tags),
        product.sku,
    )
    updated = conn.execute(
        "UPDATE products SET name = ?, cents = ?, stock = ?, tags = ? WHERE sku = ?",
        values,
    )
    if updated.rowcount == 0:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO products (name, cents, stock, tags, sku) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            values,
        )

    return f"${cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}"

    if len(product.sku) < 3 or product.cents < 0 or product.stock < 0:
        raise InvalidRequest(

        )
    with transaction() as conn:
        if find_product(conn, product.sku):
            raise ApiError("Invalid", reason=f"duplicate sku {product.sku}")
        save_product(conn, product)
    return product

    if product is None:

    return product

    if page < 1 or not 1 <= per_page <= 50:
        raise InvalidRequest("page is at least 1, and per_page is between 1 and 50")
    with transaction() as conn:
        products = sorted(all_products(conn), key=lambda p: p.sku)
    if tag is not None:
        products = [p for p in products if tag in p.tags]
    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    return products[start : start + per_page]

from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
from pydantic import TypeAdapter

from .db import transaction
from .errors import ApiError, InvalidRequest
from .schemas import Product, Restock, LowStock, Status

router = APIRouter()

def row_to_product(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Product:
    return Product(
        sku=row["sku"],
        name=row["name"],
        cents=row["cents"],
        stock=row["stock"],
        tags=json.loads(row["tags"]),
    )


def find_product(conn: sqlite3.Connection, sku: str) -> Product | None:
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM products WHERE sku = ?", (sku,)).fetchone()
    return row_to_product(row) if row else None


def all_products(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Product]:
    return [
        row_to_product(r) for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY pos")
    ]


def save_product(conn: sqlite3.Connection, product: Product) -> None:
    values = (
        product.name,
        product.cents,
        product.stock,
        json.dumps(product.tags),
        product.sku,
    )
    updated = conn.execute(
        "UPDATE products SET name = ?, cents = ?, stock = ?, tags = ? WHERE sku = ?",
        values,
    )
    if updated.rowcount == 0:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO products (name, cents, stock, tags, sku) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            values,
        )


def price_label(cents: int) -> str:
    """The price as dollars and cents, like $19.99."""
    return f"${cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}"


@router.post("/products")
def add_product(product: Product) -> Product:
    if len(product.sku) < 3 or product.cents < 0 or product.stock < 0:
        raise InvalidRequest(
            "the sku has at least 3 characters, and cents and stock are not negative"
        )
    with transaction() as conn:
        if find_product(conn, product.sku):
            raise ApiError("Invalid", reason=f"duplicate sku {product.sku}")
        save_product(conn, product)
    return product


@router.get("/products/{sku}")
def get_product(sku: str) -> Product:
    with transaction() as conn:
        product = find_product(conn, sku)
    if product is None:
        raise ApiError("Missing", sku=sku)
    return product


@router.get("/products")
def list_products(page: int, per_page: int, tag: str | None = None) -> list[Product]:
    if page < 1 or not 1 <= per_page <= 50:
        raise InvalidRequest("page is at least 1, and per_page is between 1 and 50")
    with transaction() as conn:
        products = sorted(all_products(conn), key=lambda p: p.sku)
    if tag is not None:
        products = [p for p in products if tag in p.tags]
    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    return products[start : start + per_page]


@router.patch("/products/{sku}/stock")
def restock(sku: str, body: Restock) -> Product:
    if body.amount <= 0:
        raise InvalidRequest("the amount is positive")
    with transaction() as conn:
        product = find_product(conn, sku)
        if product is None:
            raise ApiError("Missing", sku=sku)
        # validating the new stock rejects an overflow before it is saved
        updated = Product.model_validate(
            {**product.model_dump(), "stock": product.stock + body.amount}
        )
        save_product(conn, updated)
    return updated

def price_table() -> dict[str, str]:

use catalog.{CatalogError, Product, find, products}
use users.{users}

table orders: Order key id

  quantity: Int,
}

type Order {
  id: Int,
  email: String,
  lines: List[Line],
  total: Int,
  status: Status,
}

type Status =
  | Open
  | Authorized(authorization: String)
  | Paid(receipt: String)
  | Cancelled

type NewOrder {
  email: String,
  lines: List[Line],
}

type Summary {
  email: String,
  orders: Int,
  spent: Int,
}

fn line_total(l: Line) -> Int
  effects: store(products)
  ensures: result >= 0
{
  return match find(l.sku) {
    Ok(p) => p.cents * l.quantity,
    Err(_) => 0,
  }
}

api fn place_order(input: NewOrder) -> Result[Order, CatalogError]
  route: POST "/orders"
  effects: store(orders), store(products)
  requires: len(input.lines) > 0
{
  var total = 0
  for line in input.lines {
    let p = try find(line.sku)
    total = total + p.cents * line.quantity
  }
  let order = Order {
    id: next_id(orders),
    email: input.email,
    lines: input.lines,
    total: total,
    status: Open,
  }
  insert(orders, order)
  return Ok(order)
}

api fn authorize(id: Int) -> Result[Order, CatalogError]
  route: POST "/orders/{id}/authorize"
  effects: net(payments.example.com), store(orders)
{
  return match get(orders, id) {
    Some(o) => match http_post("https://payments.example.com/authorize", to_string(o.total)) {
      Ok(authorization) => Ok(save(orders, authorized(o, authorization))),
      Err(e) => Err(Missing(e.message)),
    },
    None => Err(Missing("order " + to_string(id))),
  }
}

fn authorized(o: Order, authorization: String) -> Order {
  var out = o
  out.status = Authorized(authorization)
  return out
}

api fn capture(id: Int) -> Result[Order, CatalogError]
  route: POST "/orders/{id}/capture"
  effects: net(payments.example.com), store(orders)
{
  return match get(orders, id) {
    Some(o) => match http_post("https://payments.example.com/capture", to_string(o.total)) {
      Ok(receipt) => Ok(save(orders, paid(o, receipt))),
      Err(e) => Err(Missing(e.message)),
    },
    None => Err(Missing("order " + to_string(id))),
  }
}

fn paid(o: Order, receipt: String) -> Order {
  var out = o
  out.status = Paid(receipt)
  return out
}

api fn summaries() -> List[Summary]
  route: GET "/summaries"
  effects: store(orders)
{
  let groups = group_by(scan(orders), |o| o.email)
  let rows = map(
    groups,
    |g| Summary { email: g.0, orders: len(g.1), spent: fold(g.1, 0, |acc, o| acc + o.total) },
  )
  return sort_desc_by(rows, |s| s.spent)
}

api fn open_count(email: String) -> Int
  route: GET "/orders/open"
  effects: store(orders)
{
  var n = 0
  for o in scan(orders) {
    if o.email == email {
      n = n + (match o.status {
        Open => 1,
        _ => 0,
      })
    }
  }
  return n
}
